description: HVAC duct sizing (equal friction) — Size round and rectangular HVAC duct for an airflow by the equal-friction method: calculated and next standard round diameter, velocity (fpm), actual friction rate, velocity pressure, rectangular equivalents (Huebscher equation) at common heights, optional straight-run pressure loss, and approximate tons at 400 cfm/ton. Upsizes when velocity exceeds the limit for the duct type. Params: cfm. Optional: friction (in. w.c. per 100 ft, default 0.08), type=supply|branch|return|main|commercial, height (rectangular height in), length (ft). Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
